title: DIR-065: 10/10 Adaptive Smart Partitioner (Fix PDF Footer Overlap) & High-Fidelity DOCX<->PDF Card Parity
spec: P0 DEFECTS & ARCHITECTURAL MANDATES: 1. ADAPTIVE SMART PARTITIONER (10/10 RATIO): In src/engine/hybrid/smartPartitioner.js, eliminate the 2-column grid height undercounting defect. Root cause: Certifications gave odd indices estHeight = 0 and Projects were estimated as linear 36px text instead of 70px 2-column card grid rows. For 5 projects + 5 certifications (e.g. Babu M), the partitioner fast-pathed all 10 items onto Page 1 (868px vs 878px capacity) when real DOM is 967px (+89px overflow), crushing the 5th certification card into the footer. Implement row-paired grid estimation (Math.max(cardA, cardB) + gap), calibrated card minimums (Projects >=65px, Certifications >=76px), and dynamic footer clearance (>=36px). Ensure tight profiles naturally flow multi-row cards onto Page 2 with authentic continuation headers in SmartFlowRenderer.jsx. 2. DOCX VS PDF HIGH-FIDELITY PARITY: In backend/services/docxExport.js, eliminate the visual disparity between DOCX and PDF. Upgrade buildProjectsBlock and buildCertificationsBlock to render structured 2-column OOXML tables with #f8fafc shading, subtle #e2e8f0 borders, padding, and title/meta hierarchy matching SmartProjects.jsx and SmartCertifications.jsx. Update buildModernSplitDocument to enable 2-column card mode. 3. ENVIRONMENT & CROSS-PLATFORM HYGIENE: Pure Linux-server compatible execution. Zero native OS console windows, no winget/cmd/PowerShell popups, zero diff in src/cv-templates/. Run full test suites and capture headless Playwright DOM census evidence before submitting.

plan.summary: DIR-065 P0, root causes confirmed by reading source. CONTRACTS/INVARIANTS: the partitioner page budget and the SmartFlowRenderer continuation-header contract must stay stable for all 55 templates, frozen src/cv-templates stays at git diff 0, and no native OS console/Windows tooling may be introduced (XAMPP-only, xampp-policy guard). (1) ADAPTIVE PARTITIONER: smartPartitioner.js estimates Projects as LINEAR text (28 + textHeight + 8/26) although SmartProjects.jsx renders them into the 2-column .smart-cards-grid, and Certifications only charge the row-start card (odd indices get 0) with no max() across the pair. For 5 projects + 5 certifications the fast-path packs all 10 items at 868px vs 878px capacity while the real DOM is 967px (+89px), crushing the 5th card into the footer. Fix: a shared pairGridRows row-paired estimator where each row costs Math.max(cardA, cardB) + rowGap, calibrated card floors (Projects >=65px, Certifications >=76px), and a dynamic density-scaled footer clearance >=36px. (2) DOCX<->PDF PARITY: backend/services/docxExport.js buildProjectsBlock renders a linear entry header and buildCertificationsBlock renders borderless bullet cells, so DOCX looks nothing like the PDF cards. Fix: structured 2-column OOXML card tables with #f8fafc shading, #e2e8f0 borders, cell padding and a title/meta hierarchy matching SmartProjects.jsx and SmartCertifications.jsx, plus 2-column card mode enabled in buildModernSplitDocument. UX STATES: no regression to the export surface loading state or the resume empty-section state, and a split grid row must never render an orphan or blank card (an authentic continuation header is shown instead). ACCESSIBILITY: card title/meta contrast (#0f172a / #64748b on #f8fafc) stays >=4.5:1, the project link keeps its aria semantics and keyboard focus ring, and DOCX tables stay reading-order linear for screen readers. SECURITY: every DOCX builder continues to sanitize user text via stripAllHtmlTags/safeUrl, no secrets or tokens are emitted, and colors are never taken from the client as authoritative. PERFORMANCE: row-pairing is a pure O(n) computation on the render path with no extra re-renders, keeping the sub-100ms render budget and the sub-4.0s build budget. QA: a functional partitioner suite, the DOCX parity suite, a headless Playwright DOM census that measures real card rects against the page-footer top, and the template-lab print/overflow probes over the 55 templates. No native console windows and no Windows-only tooling; all servers stay on XAMPP.
steps: 1. smartPartitioner.js: add one shared pairGridRows(cards, heightOf, rowGap, titleHeight) row-paired estimator that groups cards into rows of two and charges each row Math.max(cardA, cardB) + rowGap, with the row-start item carrying the row height and its partner carrying 0 so a row is atomic and the packer per-item sum equals the true row sum

2. smartPartitioner.js: add projectCardHeightFor(proj) calibrated to the real .smart-card-item (title 11px + url 9.5px + desc 10px/1.35, padding 7/9, 1px border, 2px gap) with a >=65px floor and ~92px ceiling, density-scaled, and replace the linear project estimate with row-paired estimation

3. smartPartitioner.js: route Certifications through the same pairGridRows estimator using certRowHeightFor (>=76px floor) so a taller partner card can no longer be under-counted (replaces the odd-index-0-without-max defect)

4. smartPartitioner.js: raise FOOTER_SAFETY_CLEARANCE to a dynamic density-scaled value >=36px and subtract it from P1_CAPACITY/PN_CAPACITY so the mandated clearance above .smart-page-footer is always reserved
5. smartEngine.css: match the .smart-page-body bottom buffer to the new clearance and add break-inside:avoid to .smart-card-item so project cards are atomic like .smart-cert-item

6. SmartFlowRenderer.jsx: verify and, if needed, tighten the group/continuation contract so a grid section that overflows Page 1 renders an authentic Projects (Continued)/Certifications (Continued) header on Page 2 with no orphan or blank card

7. backend/services/docxExport.js: add a CARD_BORDER (E2E8F0) plus a card-cell factory (shading F8FAFC, cell margins for padding) and rewrite buildProjectsBlock as a 2-column card table with title/url/description hierarchy matching SmartProjects.jsx

8. backend/services/docxExport.js: rewrite the two-column branch of buildCertificationsBlock from borderless bullet cells to real cards (bold title + issuer/date meta, F8FAFC fill, E2E8F0 border) and enable 2-column card mode for projects and certifications in buildModernSplitDocument while preserving certsBelongInSidebar
9. tests: author tests/dir065-adaptive-partitioner-docx-parity.test.mjs with functional assertions (the 5-project + 5-certification fixture must NOT fast-path all items onto Page 1

DOCX emits F8FAFC card tables) plus npm script test:dir065, and add a template-lab gridDense (Babu M) fixture with a headless Playwright partitioner-census.mjs that measures real card rects against the page-footer top and asserts zero overlap with a page-count/overflow report

10. evidence: run npm run lint, npm run test:security:static, npm run test:xampp-policy, the new suite, the DOCX/export backend suites, a test:product slice, node template-lab/run-probes.mjs --fixtures long,extreme --probes print,overflow and the census probe, and npm run build (verify sub-4.0s)
then submit the logs via bridge dev submit-evidence for Gatekeeper certification.

evidence.summary: DIR-065 COMPLETE. (1) ADAPTIVE PARTITIONER: smartPartitioner.js no longer estimates grid cards as linear text. Added a shared pairGridRows() row-paired estimator that charges each 2-column row Math.max(cardA, cardB) + rowGap, carrying the row height on the row-start card so a row is atomic; added projectCardHeightFor() calibrated to the real .smart-card-item (>=65px floor, 92px ceiling, density-scaled) replacing the old ~36px linear project estimate; routed certifications through the same estimator with certRowHeightFor (>=76px floor) so a taller partner card can no longer be under-counted; and raised the footer clearance to a dynamic, density-scaled FOOTER_SAFETY_CLEARANCE = Math.max(36, 40 * densityScale). smartEngine.css now gives .smart-card-item break-inside:avoid and a matching .smart-page-body buffer. The exact defect profile is fixed: the Babu M '5 projects + 5 certifications' fixture (template-lab/fixtures.js gridDense) previously fast-pathed all 10 cards onto page 1 at 868px vs 878px capacity while the real DOM was 967px (+89px) and crushed the 5th card into the footer; it now partitions to 2 pages with the last cert row on page 2 under an authentic continuation header. (2) DOCX<->PDF PARITY: backend/services/docxExport.js now renders structured 2-column OOXML CARD tables (CARD_FILL F8FAFC, CARD_BORDER E2E8F0, CARD_CELL_MARGINS padding, bold title + meta hierarchy) via new buildProjectCardCell() and buildCertCardCell(); buildProjectsBlock() emits title/url/description cards matching SmartProjects.jsx; buildCertificationsBlock()'s two-column branch replaces borderless bullet cells with real cards matching SmartCertifications.jsx; buildModernSplitDocument() now enables 2-column card mode for certifications. (3) ENVIRONMENT: pure Linux-server-compatible; the new template-lab/census-probe.mjs spawns no OS process, no native console, no winget/cmd/PowerShell; src/cv-templates git diff = 0; XAMPP policy guard 4/4. EVIDENCE: new tests/dir065-adaptive-partitioner-docx-parity.test.mjs 9/9 (incl. FUNCTIONAL: a row is charged the TALLER card (>=95px) not the row-start card; the 5+5 gridDense profile spills onto page 2 with project rows >=65px and cert rows >=76px; DOCX emits F8FAFC fill + E2E8F0 border + equal-width 2-column card tables carrying the 5th project and 5th certification). DIR-064+DIR-065+DIR-063 27/27 (DIR-064 constants updated for the DIR-065 supersede); backend DOCX export+parity 25/25 (the Cv4 no-split-sidebar assertion was refined from the now-ambiguous F8FAFC proxy to the real 34/66 grid-ratio check, since F8FAFC is now also the mandated card fill); product slice 115/115. HEADLESS PLAYWRIGHT DOM CENSUS: template-lab/census-probe.mjs over ALL 55 templates on the gridDense fixture -> every CV renders 2 pages / 10 cards / worstOverlap 0px; 'CENSUS PASS: no grid card overlaps the page footer across 55 template(s)'. Overflow probe (long, 55 templates): 0 clipped elements, probe failures 0. GATES: lint 0 errors (253 pre-existing warnings); security:static 67/67; xampp-policy 4/4; build 'built in 3.52s' (under the 4.0s budget). HONEST LIMITS: the DOM census proves zero card/footer overlap for the gridDense profile and the overflow probe proves zero page-bottom clipping for the long profile, but neither re-runs the exact user's original private resume; the estimator clamps project cards at 92px and cert cards at 88px, so a pathologically long (4+ line) card relies on the CSS break-inside:avoid + page-body buffer as the backstop; sidebar certifications still render as bullets in DOCX (columns:1 path) because the sidebar cell width is not threaded into the builder, so card parity is exact in the main flow but not in the sidebar.
